mapper.select: SELECT rv.*, r.id AS receipt_number, pa.name AS payment_account_name, u.name AS verified_by_name FROM receipt_verification rv LEFT JOIN receipts r ON rv.receipt_id = r.id LEFT JOIN payment_account pa ON rv.payment_account_id = pa.id LEFT JOIN users u ON rv.verified_by = u.user_id WHERE rv.id = #{id}

SELECT rv.*, r.id AS receipt_number, pa.name AS payment_account_name, u.name AS verified_by_name FROM receipt_verification rv LEFT JOIN receipts r ON rv.receipt_id = r.id LEFT JOIN payment_account pa ON rv.payment_account_id = pa.id LEFT JOIN users u ON rv.verified_by = u.user_id WHERE rv.receipt_id = #{receiptId} ORDER BY rv.verification_time DESC

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO receipt_verification (receipt_id, payment_account_id, amount, payment_method, verification_time, verified_by, remark) VALUES (#{receiptId}, #{paymentAccountId}, #{amount}, #{paymentMethod}, #{verificationTime}, #{verifiedBy}, #{remark})
